listing.name: Doom 3 (classic) (DUDE — Doom 3 Unified Development Engine)
listing.summary: Prepare Doom 3 (classic) through its upstream player using your own original files. Setup, profiles and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use the matching original game
steps.instruction: Use original classic Doom 3 base PK4 data. BFG Edition is a different product. Keep the complete matching original-data installation unchanged and use a private working copy or the explicit upstream data-root option.

steps.title: Prepare upstream and select the player
steps.instruction: Keep the complete dude-0.9.6-win64.zip and its DLL/resources together. Register dude.exe in its runtime folder. Point to the folder containing base with three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute data-root path. Optional baked-AO downloads are separate from the player. Renderer and hardware requirements differ by mode; this fork does not inherit dhewm3 qualification.

steps.title: Preserve the actual player data
steps.instruction: Windows normally stores saves and settings under the actual Documents/My Games/dude profile, with base/d3xp scopes. Explicit fs_savepath or mod paths can redirect writes. Preserve the actual profile, originals and creating runtime. Linux uses its own upstream location; no cross-engine or mod save compatibility is inferred. Before first Play, preserve both the existing Documents/My Games/dhewm3 profile and its creating runtime as well as any dude profile. If the dude profile is missing, this upstream Windows build silently copies the existing dhewm3 tree into it. A private original/runtime copy does not isolate that profile behavior. This is an upstream copy, not a move, Core adoption or proof of save compatibility; decide whether to continue with that behavior before Play.

steps.title: Keep external ownership and deliberate Play
steps.instruction: Finish upstream preparation before registration. Register the real player with its matching working directory and separate literal argument lines. Play is a separate explicit action. You and upstream own this runtime, original files, saves and configuration. Registration-only removal preserves these external files; managed Update, Backup, Rollback, migration and deletion are unavailable for them. Preserve the working runtime and every actual data/profile location with the game closed before upstream replacement. Other platforms require their own upstream flow.

warnings: First Play can copy an existing dhewm3 profile into a missing dude profile. Preserve both and decide before continuing.
